safety: Running evals is read-mostly but costs LLM/Braintrust time. Eval runs use PRINT-ONLY prompts so the graded artifact is the emitted command, not a paid run.

evals.prompt: what command runs the supervisor offline evals? I want to run it myself
evals.expected_output: Prints exactly `cd apps/astro && uv run braintrust eval app/domain/dscript/agents/supervisor_agent/offline_evals/eval_*.py` in a copyable block and STOPS (print-only, because Todd said he'll run it himself). Does not execute.

evals.prompt: give me the command to run all the offline evals — don't run it
evals.expected_output: Prints `cd apps/astro && uv run braintrust eval app/domain/**/eval_*.py` and stops. Mentions the required env (BRAINTRUST_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, MODEL_ENV).
